theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Real.P01DeterministicNTMEmbedding.runBranches_halted_all
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {State Symbol : Type} (M : MCore.Real.TM State Symbol) (accepting : State → Bool) (n : Nat)   (c : MCore.Real.Configuration State Symbol),   M.halting c.state = true → (MCore.Real.P01DeterministicNTMEmbedding.tmAsNTM M accepting).runBranches n [c] = [c]

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Real.P01DeterministicNTMEmbedding.runBranches_tmAsNTM_singleton
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {State Symbol : Type} (M : MCore.Real.TM State Symbol) (accepting : State → Bool) (n : Nat)   (c : MCore.Real.Configuration State Symbol),   (MCore.Real.P01DeterministicNTMEmbedding.tmAsNTM M accepting).runBranches n [c] = [M.run n c]

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Real.P01DeterministicNTMEmbedding.tmAsNTM_acceptsWithin_iff
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {State Symbol : Type} (M : MCore.Real.TM State Symbol) (accepting : State → Bool) (n : Nat)   (c : MCore.Real.Configuration State Symbol),   M.HaltsWithin n c →     ((MCore.Real.P01DeterministicNTMEmbedding.tmAsNTM M accepting).AcceptsWithin n c ↔       accepting (M.run n c).state = true)
